name: Favorites
harvested_from: built fresh; evidence from the org-wide sweep (7 of 39 Laravel repos had hand-rolled one)
description: Star anything. A polymorphic favourites pivot with a registry allow-list, a toggle endpoint, a Favoritable trait supplying isFavoritedBy / favoritedBy / withFavoritedBy scopes, a star button component and a My Favourites page. The registry takes an ability because the list reads a label back out of every starred record.
